limitation: Labels are weak (regex + data/lexicon/register_map.json gazetteer matching against corpus terms), never hand-corrected, per docs/PIPELINE.md's own explicit lowest-priority ranking for this topic. All metrics here measure agreement with the weak-labeling rules, not tagging quality against human-verified ground truth. v3 vs v2: token accuracy alone was misleading (O-dominated -- a model predicting O everywhere still scores high); replaced with per-entity-tag precision/recall/F1 and their macro-F1, the standard way to report a tagger. This changes what is measured, not the self-consistency caveat, which remains and is not resolved by a better metric.
